about: The decision graph for Storm CHARLES and Web Summit Lisbon, Wednesday 11 November 2026. Nodes are decision-makers and their decisions; edges are 'this usually follows that'. status: happened | expected | not_announced | unknown. 'expected' and every lead time are ANALYSIS (with reasons), never fact. Kept by weather@PrompTugal.vicky; checked against what happens. Times UTC (= Lisbon time).

legend.happened: announced by the decision-maker, read at source
legend.expected: ANALYSIS: likely next, with the reason
legend.not_announced: nothing from this decision-maker as of the time read

nodes.decision: Names the low CHARLES; communiqué no. 1 says orange warnings will follow, an upgrade not ruled out
Public warning Aviso 21: gusts to 120 km/h, avoid unnecessary travel
Red wind warning, Lisbon district, Wed 12:00 to 21:00 (gusts to 120, up to 140 km/h)
nodes.at: first seen 2026-11-10T14:14Z (issue time not published in the feed)

nodes.decision: Special readiness of the civil-protection system raised; SMS warning to the public about Wednesday

nodes.who: Government (Minister of Internal Administration and eight others)
nodes.decision: Situação de alerta, all mainland Portugal, Wed 00:00 to 23:59, under Lei 27/2006 arts. 8(6), 9(1), 14

nodes.who: Government (measure a, co-signed by the Minister of Education)
nodes.decision: Schools and non-essential public services closed on Wednesday
Outdoor events suspended, whatever their nature; parks at risk and the waterfront closed (c, e)
Rain raised to red, Lisbon district, Wed 12:00 to 18:00; communiqué no. 2 brings the worsening to early Wednesday morning

nodes.who: Autoridade Marítima Nacional and the Navy
nodes.decision: Sea warning, Wed 06:00 to Thu 12:00; no Tagus bar closure found

nodes.who: Câmara Municipal de Lisboa (the mayor; municipal civil-protection commission)
nodes.decision: Municipal measures, municipal alert or emergency plan (partly seen: the homeless-people contingency plan, through Metro)
nodes.note: Seen through Metro de Lisboa (read 2026-11-10T19:36Z): with the Lisbon and Amadora councils, under the Plano de Contingência para Pessoas em Situação de Sem-Abrigo, five Metro stations open overnight 10-11 and 11-12 Nov 'face às previsões de agravamento das condições meteorológicas'. The city's other measures: lisboa.pt refuses automated reads (403); a person must read it.

nodes.who: Operators (Metro, Carris, Carris Metropolitana, Fertagus, CP, Transtejo/Soflusa)
nodes.decision: Suspension or reduced service on Wednesday
nodes.note: Fertagus, Carris and Carris Metropolitana warn of possible disruption; ferries cut one route on Tuesday; no suspension for Wednesday
ANA's site returns a bot check; not read

nodes.decision: End of measures and reopening (Thursday 12 November)
nodes.note: The alert ends at 23:59 on Wednesday by its own terms

edges.lead_now: under 25 hours (red seen by 14:14Z on 10 Nov)
same day; the declaration cites the raised readiness
edges.evidence: gov-alert source: 'Considerando a elevação do estado de prontidão especial do SIOPS'

edges.history: ANALYSIS: in past storms councils closed schools on the morning of the storm (Kristin, Jan 2026); here the government did it a day ahead (history.md)
ANALYSIS: no past case found of a government order closing events; in 2019 the organiser and the council did (history.md)

edges.why: ANALYSIS: the declaration activates the civil-protection commissions, which assess the municipal emergency plan (Lei 27/2006 art. 14(3); law.md); Lisbon's mayor closed all gardens on his own in Feb 2026 (history.md)

ANALYSIS: past suspensions came on the day of impact and reactively (ferries Elsa 2019, rail Kristin 2026); a decision is most likely on Wednesday morning or as gusts arrive, ferries first (history.md; TTSL already cut a route on Tuesday)

ANALYSIS: measure (b) covers outdoor events only; whether any outdoor part of the summit is affected is the organiser's and the authorities' call; Web Summit has said nothing. No prediction of the programme is made here
ANALYSIS: an organiser follows the venue's and the authorities' orders (Lei 27/2006 arts. 6, 11; law.md)
ANALYSIS: in Kristin (Jan 2026) a calamity was declared after impact, backdated (history.md); only if the damage warrants it
ANALYSIS: the warning ends at 21:00 Wed and the alert at 23:59 Wed; decisions to reopen come after the damage is known; history gives few sourced reopening times
